card.name: Just before HIV drug names in interactions
card.fires_on: Punctuation, linking words or 'inhibitors' right before an HIV antiretroviral drug name (ritonavir, nelfinavir, lopinavir, tenofovir) in drug-interaction lists. Also the middle of 'trazodone' in an HIV drug interaction.

modes.label: Before protease inhibitor names
modes.description: 'inhibitors' or 'like' sits right before a named HIV protease inhibitor.

modes.label: Lists of HIV drugs
modes.description: A comma, 'e.g.,' or 'and' in a list of antiretrovirals, just before the next drug name.
modes.example: in combination with AZT, indinavir<<,>> d4T, famciclov

modes.label: Inside trazodone
modes.description: Partway through 'trazodone' in a note about co-use with an HIV protease inhibitor.

card.plain: It fires on the small word or comma just before the next HIV drug is named in an interaction list.
